observations.text: RUN (reviewer, under flock): argv `dotnet test Lighthouse.Backend/Lighthouse.Backend.Tests --filter FullyQualifiedName~Lighthouse.Backend.Tests.Architecture` on clean tree at a76ac5eab; exit 1; stdout "Failed! - Failed: 9, Passed: 2210, Skipped: 0, Total: 2219, Duration: 5 m 31 s". The 9 failures are exactly TheRulePattern_KeepsItsDeclaredRole_WhenThePublishedTypesMoveIntoContracts for the 9 FrontDoor fields (AccessApplication; ConnectorPort; FlowMetricsInbound FlowMetricsApplication; Forecasting FlowMetricsApplication and ForecastingApplication; LicensingApplication; TrackerIntegrationApplication; WorkItems FlowMetricsApplication and WorkItemsApplication), each "StopsSeeingTheType: X: ...Application -> matches, ...Contracts -> does not match". Semantic RED; no collection/import/fixture failure; every membership, closure, undeclared-field, rename-sweep and made-up-fixture test and every earlier Architecture test (incl. closed Stories 6468/6657 laws reading the changed NamespaceMoveLaw.cs) passed. stderr: a FATAL AllowedOrigins line from a test-host log, not a failure. JUDGMENT 1 classification: FrontDoor = 9 fields owning a context layer other code reaches (Application, plus ConnectorPort). Place = layout namespace strings of layers a type leaves, kernel (Models) patterns, and LicensingModuleBoundariesArchUnitTest.AccessApplication (a legal-caller pattern: Access.Contracts types call nothing, so not seeing Contracts is correct and stricter). Context = whole-context/backend patterns. Roles map is checked both ways (undeclared and stale) and a Place field naming Contracts is a break, so a wrong class fails by name. Sound.

JUDGMENT 2 craft = 9 widenings: the 9 red lines are the complete craft. The unit-test placement tests hold per-class (file, layer) rows and test-folder paths, no layer regex field the law reads, so the design layer-set admission (F162) needs no edit now; a Contracts test-folder row is a later feature concern. Note, not finding.

JUDGMENT 3 rename list: 43 entries, each in one file in exactly one form (checked both ways, with made-up flat/grouped/absent/both fixture falsifiers). Entries naming closed-Story oracles (OrganisationSetupStringsTheMoveRenames, OrganisationSetupMembershipArchUnitTest grouped regex, WriteBackMembership, WriteBackRoundBoundariesArchUnitTest, OrganisationSetupIsAnOpenHostArchUnitTest) follow the 6657 precedent; feature C edits those files under the declared renames.

JUDGMENT 4 NOTE: WorkItemsModuleBoundariesArchUnitTest.SetUpOpenToTheContextsBuildingOnIt and AccessLicensingOrganisationSetUpAndTheUpdateQueue are C# properties (`@"Lighthouse\.Backend\.Modules\.OrganisationSetup\.(Application|Domain)(\.|$)"`) unread by the law, so the WorkItems exemption does not yet admit OrganisationSetup.Contracts. No S1 verdict changes; when IAppSettingService/IBlackoutPeriodService/IFeatureOrdering move, that rule flags the edge unless C5 widens it. Disclosed by the designer as C5 scope; not an S1 defect.

JUDGMENT 5 closure: measured set = reached shapes + events + same-context public-signature closure, compared with the map both ways (published, behaviour, not-published list); made-up Beta fixture names a listed behaviour class (BetaCalculator), a missing closure member (BetaAnswer) and an unlisted reached behaviour class, and passes. Each entry has a per-entry lookup line (Seed/Closure, old and new namespace). Capability limit: IL reading misses event declarations and named attribute arguments (root context), so a type reached only that way is not measured.
